page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, indicating that hyperthreading is not active on this instance. The server is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per physical core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It does not feature any GPU accelerators. Additionally, advanced CPU instruction sets and hardware-assisted features, such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI), and virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM), are not available on this hardware profile.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers an entry-level, dedicated resource profile suitable for workloads that require predictable CPU allocation without the overhead of shared-core burstable models. Given the absence of advanced instruction sets and local storage, this instance is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, small databases, and development or testing environments that do not rely on heavy parallel processing or vector calculations.
